edges.reason: constructor token parameter is written into the _token state variable
constructor beneficiary parameter is written into the _beneficiary state variable
constructor releaseTime parameter is written into the _releaseTime state variable
constructor guard releaseTime > block.timestamp makes deployment depend on block time
release() guard block.timestamp >= _releaseTime makes release depend on block time
_releaseTime is read by release() to decide whether tokens may be withdrawn
release() reads _token.balanceOf(address(this)) to compute the payout amount
release() invokes SafeERC20.safeTransfer on the held token
_beneficiary is passed as the recipient argument of safeTransfer
local amount is passed as the value argument of safeTransfer
safeTransfer delegates to the private optional-return routine that performs the low-level external call
the low-level call targets a caller-influenceable token contract which can re-enter release()
